LanguageData.LC_ScorchedGirl_EscapedText: {0} breached containment with a lit 20-second matchstick fuse! Shoot her down before she closes in!
LanguageData.LC_ScorchedGirl_KilledText: {0} was suppressed cleanly before her match detonated.
LanguageData.LC_ScorchedGirl_DetonatedMsg: Scorched Girl detonated in a blinding Red explosion and returned to her egg!
LanguageData.LC_DerFreischutz_LowJusticeMsg: {0}'s low Justice angered Der Freischütz, lowering his Qliphoth Counter!
LanguageData.LC_DerFreischutz_MeltdownText: Der Freischütz's Qliphoth Counter hit zero! He loosed a rogue piercing Magic Bullet blindly through the colony.
LanguageData.LC_DerFreischutz_SeventhShotMsg: The seventh Magic Bullet twisted Fate—tearing straight toward {0}!
LanguageData.LC_DerFreischutz_RequestShotDesc: Spend {0} IndiPE-Box to fire a map-spanning piercing Black round. (Current cycle: {1} / 7; every 7th targets a random colonist!)
LanguageData.LC_Funeral_EscapedText: {0} rose in silent mourning and breached containment! Brace for dual White/Black salvos and butterfly coffin bursts.
LanguageData.LC_Funeral_BadVirtueMsg: {0}'s incompatible Fortitude/Justice distressed Funeral of the Dead Butterflies, dropping its Qliphoth Counter!
LanguageData.LC_SnowQueen_FirstKissMsg: The Snow Queen pressed a frost-petal Kiss onto {0}. Do not risk another Kiss within 24 hours!
LanguageData.LC_SnowQueen_FrozenLetterText: A second Kiss trapped {0} inside The Snow Queen's ice coffin and halted all normal work! Win a "Duel for Rescue" within 90 seconds before they shatter to death.
LanguageData.LC_SnowQueen_FreezeTimeoutMsg: The Snow Queen's 90-second timer expired—{0} shattered to death inside the ice!
LanguageData.LC_SnowQueen_DuelWinLetterText: {0} defeated The Snow Queen and melted {1} free! Both heroes received The Snow Queen's E.G.O. Gift.
LanguageData.LC_SnowQueen_DuelLossLetterText: {0} fell in The Snow Queen's trial, claiming both challenger and {1} in a deadly frost burst.
LanguageData.LC_SnowQueen_DuelGizmoDesc: Send a colonist to duel The Snow Queen and rescue {0}. Win rate scales with Fortitude (10%/30%/50%/80%/100%).
LanguageData.LC_SnowQueen_StudyBlockedFrozen: {0} is sealed inside the ice coffin—rescue via Duel first.
LanguageData.LC_ResearcherNote_EquipGizmoDesc: Choose a colonist to carry Notes from a Crazed Researcher (+50% Work, Research & Study Speed, +10% Study Success Rate). Must be held for 30s with at least 1 completed non-tool Abnormality study before return, and reaching 60 cumulative HP/SP damage (Black counts double) is fatal.
LanguageData.LC_ResearcherNote_ReturnGizmoDesc: Order {0} to return the notebook to its holding pedestal.
LanguageData.LC_ResearcherNote_EquipMsg: {0} took Notes from a Crazed Researcher. Complete 1 Abnormality study & hold 30s before returning; avoid reaching 60 cumulative damage!
LanguageData.LC_ResearcherNote_PrematureExplodeMsg: {0} returned the Crazed Researcher's Notes before completing 1 Abnormality study and 30 seconds—the bearer detonated in a gore blast!
LanguageData.LC_ResearcherNote_DamageExplodeMsg: {0} reached 60 cumulative HP/SP damage while holding the Crazed Researcher's Notes, triggering a fatal RED gore explosion!
LanguageData.LC_ResearcherNote_DangerWarningMsg: WARNING: {0}'s Crazed Researcher's Notes are swelling violently ({1} / {2} cumulative damage)!
LanguageData.LC_ResearcherNote_SafeReadyMsg: {0} satisfied the Crazed Researcher's conditions—the notebook may now be returned safely.
LanguageData.LC_ResearcherNote_SafeReturnMsg: {0} fulfilled the Crazed Researcher's conditions and returned the notebook safely.
LanguageData.LC_ResearcherNote_HediffTip: Cumulative damage: {0} / {1} | Studies: {2} | Study success +{3}% (safe return needs 30s + 1 study)
